title: Guava and Cream Cheese Puff Pastry Waffle
changes_from_base: No batter at all: a sheet of puff pastry spread with cream cheese and sliced guava paste, rolled up, coiled into a spiral and cooked in the waffle iron until it reaches 93 °C, then cut into wedges.
summary: A spiral of flaky puff pastry filled with cream cheese and sweet guava paste, cooked in the waffle iron until deeply golden and dusted with icing sugar.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Dust the work surface and the 225 g sheet of thawed puff pastry with flour, then roll it into a square about 40 x 40 cm.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread 230 g cream cheese over the pastry, leaving a 2.5 cm border, and lay the 115 g sliced guava paste evenly on top.

steps.title: Coil
steps.text: Roll the pastry away from you like a Swiss roll, pinch the seam and ends to seal, then coil it into a flat spiral.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Place the spiral in the centre of the hot iron and cook until deep golden brown all over and an instant-read thermometer reads 93 °C in the centre, about 12 min.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Lift onto a board, slice into wedges, dust with icing sugar and serve at once.

tips: Slice the guava paste thinly and lay it evenly so every wedge gets some filling.
Check the centre with an instant-read thermometer rather than relying on colour alone, since the spiral is thicker than a usual waffle.
Cut and serve the wedges at once, while the pastry is still crisp.
storage: Best eaten fresh and warm, straight from the iron. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
